name: Kazuma to Kugayama no Kimyou na Haikou Tanken
original_name: カズマと久我山の奇妙な廃校探検
source:
Kazuma (straight) is a big horror freak, so when his friend Kuga (gay) invites him on a test of courage in an old school, he follows along, but when they get there, Kuga says that every time Kazuma gets scared, he gets to do "something sexy"...!?
It's not super scary and there's no game overs. Also it's only R15; there's no 18+ CGs, so don't expect that.

[From https://boards.fireden.net/y/thread/2673197/]
translation:
Kazuma（异性恋）是个十足的恐怖片迷。好友Kuga（同性恋）邀他到一所废弃学校试胆，他便跟了过去。可刚到那里，Kuga就说：只要Kazuma被吓到，他就能和Kazuma做一件“色色的事”！？作品不会特别吓人，也没有Game Over。本作只有R15级，不会有R18 CG，别抱这样的期待。
